newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on Cyprus 91 day t-bills at 5.65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on Cyprus 91 day t-bills at 5.65 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday sold 9.0 million pounds ($17.7 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills with a coupon of 5.65 percent, from 5.62 percent at the last auction on February 12.

A central bank statement said it had offered up to 15 million in bills. Total bids submitted amounted to 17.5 million pounds and the bank accepted competitive and non competitive bids for 9.0 million pounds worth in bills.
Treasury bill auctions are held twice a month.
